hints.title: Earliest Opponent Elimination Strategy
hints.text: A senator should always ban the very next upcoming opponent to minimize the opponent team immediate voting power.

hints.title: Two FIFO Line Traversal
hints.text: Keep track of senator turn indices for each party in two separate collections. Compare head indices to see who acts first in the current round.

hints.title: Index Re-enqueueing for Next Round
hints.text: Pop both heads. The smaller index bans the larger index, then the winner is re-enqueued with its index increased by n to participate in future rounds.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of the senate string
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N) time and linear O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string modifications or linear scans per elimination take quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two index buffers track round order cleanly in O(1) time per elimination.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that re-adding index plus n naturally preserves cyclic turn order.
